notes: This candidate trace covers one FOM-added interaction class directly beneath HLAmanager.HLAfederate, outside the §11.3.1 RTI-send HLAreport branch and RTI-receive HLAadjust/HLArequest/HLAservice branches. The public-API case confirms ordinary federate-to-federate routing and that the RTI does not process the switch-shaped parameter as HLAsetSwitches. Its §11.4.1 mapping is limited to this one observable absence of a MOM side effect; it does not establish the broad prohibition exhaustively. It does not enumerate all possible category-c classes, inspect the RTI's internal subscription set, or claim conformance.

requirements.statement: Classes of interaction in this category shall be neither sent nor received by the RTI.
These classes of interaction shall be ignored by the RTI and may be formed in any way that is consistent with IEEE 1516.2 federation object model (FOM) development.

requirements.source_symbol: No other RTI activity with regard to MOM
requirements.statement: Other than registering and deleting object instances, updating instance attributes, and sending and receiving interactions, the RTI shall not engage in any other activity with regard to MOM.
